changes.title: No dodge marker
items: The little cyan diamond showing where a dodge would land is gone; dodging works as before

changes.title: Ring stone dots
items: The dancefloor ring's runestones are carved with three glowing dots, one above another: the speaker each will become

changes.title: Ring runestones face
items: The dancefloor ring's runestones are turned like its speakers: the far ones face the dancefloor and the near ones face out to us
